l.i: Vitreis oculis novis gemellis Gemelli iuvenum vigent ocelli, Gemellique senum vident ocelli.

Nunc vos luminibus meis misellis Certam fertis opem benigniora Vestris lucidulis specilla flammis. Sic Phoebi, Charitum, & novem sororum Interesse mihi licet Choreis. Sic clara licet eruditione Semper volvere nobiles libellos.
Ad Ioannem Baptistam Rothanum, in Ecclesia Genevensi verbi Dei ministrum.

Si tecum mihi nunc licet iocari, Et nugas dare nobiles amico, Salsque innocuos, facetiasque: Defunctli Culicis, Rothane, Manes Mitto pallidulos, minutulosque. Rides? Limpidula videre fas est Iamiam (ni tibi lippiant ocelli) Illos molliter urnula iacentes:

page.notes: Opening stanza lines and the dedication are set in italic; the initial S is a large woodcut-style initial joined to "i tecum" as printed. Printing irregularities (e.g. "Defunctli", "Salèsque", "Interesse") left as printed. Some words in the upper verse are faint and read with some uncertainty, notably "nouem" and "lippiant".
